Co-Founder

Paul has 20+ years of experience developing, owning and managing multifamily and mixed-use buildings in NYC. Prior to founding Patoma, he worked at McKinsey & Company. He has a degree in Systems Engineering from the University of Pennsylvania.

Tom Finnican

Co-Founder

Tom has 20+ years of experience developing, owning and managing multifamily and mixed-use buildings in NYC with a focus on construction. Prior to founding Patoma, he ran development for a family office. He has a degree in Economics and Sociology from the University of Pennsylvania.
